articles.title_en: Credit Supply Shocks and Prices: Evidence from Danish Firms
articles.title_cn: 信贷供给冲击与价格：来自丹麦企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the response of firms’ output prices to a cut in credit supply. We combine data on loans between Danish firms and banks with survey-based producer prices and transaction-based export unit values. Exploiting banks’ heterogeneous exposure to the global financial crisis, we show that loans to firms with relationships to exposed banks drop and lending rates increase. In response, firms raise prices by 3–5 percent. This effect is decreasing in the elasticity of firms’ demand but positive for most industrial production. Our results show that firms increase prices to raise cash when external sources of liquidity dry up. (JEL D22, E23, E31, E32, E44, G01, G21)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业产出价格对信贷供给削减的反应。我们结合了丹麦企业与银行之间的贷款数据、基于调查的生产者价格以及基于交易的出口单位价值。利用银行对全球金融危机的不同敞口，我们表明，与受冲击银行有关系的企业的贷款下降，贷款利率上升。作为回应，企业将价格提高3-5%。这种效应随着企业需求弹性的增加而减小，但对大多数工业生产而言是正向的。我们的结果表明，当外部流动性来源枯竭时，企业会提高价格以增加现金。（JEL D22, E23, E31, E32, E44, G01, G21）

articles.title_en: Dynamism Diminished: The Role of Housing Markets and Credit Conditions
articles.title_cn: 活力减弱：住房市场与信贷条件的作用
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of house price changes on young-firm employment shares and industry-level employment growth in local economies. A novel test shows that house price effects on local economies work through wealth, liquidity, and collateral effects on the propensity to start new firms and expand young ones. Aggregating local effects to the national level, our estimates imply that housing market ups and downs play a major role—as transmission channel and driving force—in medium-run fluctuations in young-firm employment shares in recent decades. We also find a distinct and smaller role for locally exogenous loan-supply shifts. (JEL D22, E24, E32, G21, L25, R11, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了房价变化对地方经济中年轻企业就业份额和行业层面就业增长的影响。一项新颖的检验表明，房价对地方经济的影响通过财富、流动性和抵押品效应作用于创办新企业和扩张年轻企业的倾向。将地方效应加总到全国层面，我们的估计意味着住房市场的起伏在近几十年的中期波动中，作为传导渠道和驱动力量，对年轻企业就业份额起着重要作用。我们还发现，地方外生的贷款供给变动的作用较小且明显不同。（JEL D22, E24, E32, G21, L25, R11, R31）

articles.title_en: Financial Frictions, Capital Misallocation, and Input-Output Linkages
articles.title_cn: 金融摩擦、资本错配与投入产出关联
articles.abstract_en: I study how input-output linkages amplify the aggregate impact of sectoral financial distortions in a dynamic general equilibrium model with endogenous capital wedges. The aggregate impact of a shock can be decomposed into weighted productivity changes and changes in allocative efficiency. A systematic uncertainty shock induces heterogenous responses in sectoral capital wedges, reducing allocative efficiency and aggregate total factor productivity (TFP). However, idiosyncratic sectoral uncertainty shocks may improve allocative efficiency and raise TFP. I then calibrate the model to US data. The network amplification magnitude on aggregate TFP ranges from 1.58 to 1.7. (JEL E22, E23, E25, E32, E44, G20, G30)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了在一个具有内生资本楔子的动态一般均衡模型中，投入产出关联如何放大部门金融扭曲的总体影响。冲击的总体影响可以分解为加权生产率变化和配置效率变化。系统性不确定性冲击引起部门资本楔子的异质性反应，降低配置效率和全要素生产率（TFP）。然而，异质性部门不确定性冲击可能改善配置效率并提高TFP。然后我将模型校准到美国数据。网络放大对总体TFP的影响幅度在1.58到1.7之间。（JEL E22, E23, E25, E32, E44, G20, G30）

articles.title_en: Ambiguity Aversion and Heterogeneity in Households’ Beliefs
articles.title_cn: 模糊厌恶与家庭信念的异质性
articles.abstract_en: UK households that wish for lower inflation and lower nominal interest rates have higher expected inflation. We interpret the evidence through the lens of a New Keynesian model where ambiguity-averse households differ in wealth, skill, labor market participation, and the receipt of government transfers and are subject to Knightian uncertainty. Households act based on beliefs that are negatively affected by their wishes, the more so the greater the amount of uncertainty. Using indirect inference, we find substantial output costs due to uncertainty. Monetary policy uncertainty contributes little to the costs because households generally dislike monetary expansions. (JEL D12, D81, D83, E12, E31, E43, E52)
articles.abstract_cn: 英国那些希望降低通胀和降低名义利率的家庭，其预期通胀率反而更高。我们通过一个新颖凯恩斯主义模型的视角来解释这一证据，在该模型中，具有模糊厌恶的家庭在财富、技能、劳动力市场参与以及政府转移支付接收方面存在差异，并面临奈特式不确定性。家庭的行为基于其信念，而这些信念受到其愿望的负面影响，且不确定性越大，这种负面影响越强。通过间接推断，我们发现不确定性导致了可观的产出成本。货币政策不确定性对这些成本的贡献较小，因为家庭普遍不喜欢货币扩张。(JEL D12, D81, D83, E12, E31, E43, E52)

articles.title_en: The Heterogeneous Effects of Social Assistance and Unemployment Insurance: Evidence from a Life Cycle Model of Family Labor Supply and Savings
articles.title_cn: 社会救助与失业保险的异质性效应：来自家庭劳动供给与储蓄生命周期模型的证据
articles.abstract_en: We empirically analyze the heterogeneous welfare effects of unemployment insurance and social assistance. We estimate a structural life cycle model of singles’ and married couples’ labor supply and savings decisions. The model includes heterogeneity by age, education, wealth, sex, and household composition. In aggregate, social assistance dominates unemployment insurance; however, the opposite holds true for married men, whose leisure time declines more than that of their spouses when unemployment insurance is reduced. A revenue-neutral rebalancing of social support away from unemployment insurance and toward social assistance increases aggregate welfare. Income pooling in married households decreases the welfare value of social assistance. (JEL D13, D15, G51, I38, J22, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实证分析了失业保险和社会救助的异质性福利效应。我们估计了一个包含单身和已婚夫妇劳动供给与储蓄决策的结构性生命周期模型。该模型包含了年龄、教育、财富、性别和家庭构成的异质性。总体而言，社会救助优于失业保险；然而，对于已婚男性而言，情况恰恰相反，当失业保险减少时，他们的闲暇时间比其配偶减少得更多。将社会支持从失业保险转向社会救助的收入中性再平衡提高了总体福利。已婚家庭中的收入汇集降低了社会救助的福利价值。（JEL D13, D15, G51, I38, J22, J64, J65）

articles.abstract_en: This paper uses a rich quantitative model with endogenous skill acquisition to show that capital-skill complementarity provides a quantitatively significant rationale to tax capital for redistributive governments. The optimal capital income tax rate is 67 percent, while it is 61 percent in an identically calibrated model without capital-skill complementarity. The skill premium falls from 1.9 to 1.84 along the transition following the optimal reform in the capital-skill complementarity model, implying substantial indirect redistribution from skilled to unskilled workers. These results show that a redistributive government should take into account capital-skill complementarity when taxing capital. (JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用一个具有内生技能获取的丰富定量模型，表明资本-技能互补性为再分配型政府征收资本税提供了数量上显著的理由。最优资本所得税率为67%，而在没有资本-技能互补性的相同校准模型中，该税率为61%。在资本-技能互补性模型中，最优改革后的转型过程中，技能溢价从1.9降至1.84，这意味着从技能工人向非技能工人进行了大量的间接再分配。这些结果表明，再分配型政府在征收资本税时应考虑资本-技能互补性。（JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, J24, J31）

articles.title_en: Inequality, Taxation, and Sovereign Default Risk
articles.title_cn: 不平等、税收与主权违约风险
articles.abstract_en: Income inequality and worker migration significantly affect sovereign default risk. Governments often impose progressive taxes to reduce inequality, which redistribute income but discourage labor supply and induce emigration. Reduced labor supply and a smaller high-income workforce erode the current and future tax base, reducing government’s ability to repay debt. I develop a sovereign default model with endogenous nonlinear taxation and heterogeneous labor to quantify this effect. In the model, the government chooses the optimal combination of taxation and debt, considering its impact on workers’ labor and migration decisions. Income inequality accounts for one-fifth of the average US state government spread. (JEL D31, F34, H21, H23, H74, J61, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 收入不平等和工人迁移显著影响主权违约风险。政府通常实施累进税以减少不平等，这虽然重新分配了收入，但抑制了劳动力供给并引发移民。劳动力供给减少和高收入劳动力规模缩小侵蚀了当前和未来的税基，降低了政府偿还债务的能力。我构建了一个具有内生非线性税收和异质性劳动的主权违约模型来量化这一效应。在该模型中，政府选择税收和债务的最优组合，同时考虑其对工人劳动和迁移决策的影响。收入不平等解释了美国各州政府平均利差的五分之一。（JEL D31, F34, H21, H23, H74, J61, R23）

articles.title_en: Testing the Effectiveness of Unconventional Monetary Policy in Japan and the United States
articles.title_cn: 检验日本和美国非常规货币政策的有效性
articles.abstract_en: Unconventional monetary policy (UMP) may make the effective lower bound (ELB) on the short-term interest rate irrelevant. We develop a theoretical model that underpins our empirical test of this “irrelevance hypothesis,” based on the simple idea that under the hypothesis, the short rate can be excluded in any empirical model that accounts for alternative measures of monetary policy. We test the hypothesis for Japan and the United States using a structural vector autoregressive model with the ELB. We firmly reject the hypothesis but find that UMP has had strong delayed effects. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E43, E52, E58)
articles.abstract_cn: 非常规货币政策（UMP）可能使短期利率的有效下限（ELB）变得无关紧要。我们开发了一个理论模型，为这一“无关性假说”的实证检验提供基础，其基本思想是，在该假说下，短期利率可以从任何考虑替代货币政策措施的实证模型中排除。我们使用带有ELB的结构向量自回归模型对日本和美国进行了假说检验。我们坚决拒绝该假说，但发现UMP具有强烈的延迟效应。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E43, E52, E58）

articles.title_cn: 空间均衡中的地方纽带
articles.abstract_en: Someone who lives in an economically depressed place was probably born there. And having workers with local ties who prefer to live in their birthplaces leads to smaller migration responses in depressed places. Smaller migration responses lead to lower real incomes and make incomes more volatile, a form of hysteresis. Local ties can also persist for generations. Subsidies to economically depressed places cause smaller distortions, because few people want to move to depressed places. Finally, subsidies to productive places increase aggregate productivity, as they induce more migration. (JEL J22, J23, J31, J61, R23, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 生活在经济萧条地区的人很可能出生在那里。拥有偏好居住于出生地的本地纽带工人，会导致萧条地区的迁移反应较小。较小的迁移反应导致实际收入降低，并使收入波动性增大，这是一种滞后效应。地方纽带也可能持续数代人。对经济萧条地区的补贴造成的扭曲较小，因为很少有人愿意迁往萧条地区。最后，对生产性地区的补贴会提高总体生产率，因为它们会诱发更多迁移。（JEL J22, J23, J31, J61, R23, Z13）

articles.title_en: Sectoral Heterogeneity in Nominal Price Rigidity and the Origin of Aggregate Fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 名义价格刚性中的部门异质性与总体波动的起源
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of heterogeneity in nominal price rigidity for aggregate fluctuations in a model with sectoral productivity shocks. Theoretically, sectoral heterogeneity in the pricing friction has an ambiguous effect on GDP and aggregate price volatility. Quantitatively, (i) GDP volatility is amplified when the friction is heterogeneous rather than homogeneous; (ii) sectoral shocks can jointly rationalize the volatility of sectoral prices, aggregate prices, and GDP, unlike aggregate shocks; and (iii) shocks to the largest or most central sectors may not matter in the aggregate as heterogeneous pricing frictions may alter the identity of the most important sectors for aggregate fluctuations. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有部门生产率冲击的模型中，名义价格刚性的异质性对总体波动的作用。理论上，定价摩擦中的部门异质性对GDP和总体价格波动的影响是模糊的。定量上，(i) 当摩擦是异质性而非同质性时，GDP波动性被放大；(ii) 部门冲击可以共同合理化部门价格、总体价格和GDP的波动性，这与总体冲击不同；(iii) 对最大或最核心部门的冲击可能不会在总体上产生影响，因为异质性的定价摩擦可能改变对总体波动最重要的部门的身份。(JEL E12, E23, E31, E32)

articles.title_en: How to Construct Nationally Representative Firm-Level Data from the Orbis Global Database: New Facts on SMEs and Aggregate Implications for Industry Concentration
articles.title_cn: 如何从Orbis全球数据库构建全国代表性的企业层面数据：关于中小企业的新事实及其对行业集中度的总体影响
articles.abstract_en: We construct nationally representative firm-level longitudinal data for European countries using financial statements from the Orbis database. We validate our data by comparing its coverage and firm size distribution to official statistics. We showcase two applications to show the importance of firm representativeness in understanding macroeconomic outcomes. First, we show that small and medium-sized firms account for a large share of aggregate economic activity. Second, we document that firm representativeness is important for calculating industry concentration trends over time as the share of economic activity accounted by top firms in an industry changes with the firm samples used. (JEL C81, D22, G30, L11, L25, L60)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用Orbis数据库中的财务报表，为欧洲国家构建了具有全国代表性的企业层面纵向数据。我们通过将数据覆盖范围和企业规模分布与官方统计进行比较来验证数据。我们展示了两个应用，以说明企业代表性在理解宏观经济结果中的重要性。首先，我们表明中小企业在总体经济活动中占很大份额。其次，我们记录了企业代表性对于计算行业集中度随时间变化趋势的重要性，因为行业前几大企业所占经济活动份额会随着所使用的企业样本而变化。(JEL C81, D22, G30, L11, L25, L60)

articles.title_en: Uncertainty and Information Acquisition: Evidence from Firms and Households
articles.title_cn: 不确定性与信息获取：来自企业和家庭的证据
articles.abstract_en: We leverage the small open economy Switzerland as a testing ground for basic premises of macroeconomic models of endogenous information acquisition, using tailored surveys of firms and households. Firms and households perceiving a greater exposure to exchange rate fluctuations acquire more information about the exchange rate. Moreover, higher perceived costs of acquiring or processing information are associated with lower levels of information acquisition. Finally, an exogenous increase in the perceived uncertainty of the exchange rate increases firms’ demand for a report about exchange rate developments, but not households’. Our findings inform the modeling of information frictions in macroeconomics. (JEL D12, D22, D81, D83, D84, E71, F31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用小型开放经济体瑞士作为检验宏观经济内生信息获取模型基本前提的试验场，采用针对企业和家庭的定制调查。感知到更大汇率波动风险的企业和家庭会获取更多关于汇率的信息。此外，感知到的获取或处理信息的成本越高，信息获取水平越低。最后，感知到的汇率不确定性的外生增加会提高企业对汇率发展报告的需求，但不会提高家庭的需求。我们的发现为宏观经济学中信息摩擦的建模提供了信息。（JEL D12, D22, D81, D83, D84, E71, F31）
